propositions: Maintained documentation incorrectly describes plan-review, completion-verifier, and verify-signature as HMAC-based when they now implement asymmetric DSSE and SSHSIG operation-certificate contracts

Documentation across attest-substrate, config, exit-codes, identity, and llm-framework contains stale HMAC references that must be corrected to reflect current Ed25519 and environment-attributed asymmetric signing

Source docstrings in _lib_identity.py, _mcp_reads.py, and resign.py describe signing and verification as HMAC operations but now produce and verify asymmetric op-cert envelopes with principal and material_fingerprint fields
Generic HMAC utility APIs (rebar.signing.compute_signature, verify_record) must remain documented for non-operation-certificate consumers and are not affected by the correction
Historical ADRs, migration records, and experiment corpora must remain unchanged; only maintained guidance and generated references (via canonical generators) are updated
